title: Nvidia stops disclosing Singapore sales as reported revenue reaches $104B
summary: The Financial Times reported that Nvidia stopped disclosing Singapore sales as the revenue figure tied to that disclosure reached $104B. The omission matters to investors and supply-chain analysts who used the Singapore line to monitor routed GPU orders and export-control exposure. Commenters cautioned that the $104B is revenue booked through Nvidia&\#x27;s Singapore subsidiary, including orders routed by OEMs, ODMs, and resellers, so it does not show where the chips are ultimately used.
